name: io.github.RidioDevelopment/socialcrawl
title: SocialCrawl
description: One API for social, commerce, travel, jobs, finance and web data, with exact credit pricing.

tools.name: socialcrawl_find
tools.description: Start here: a task in plain words -> the best endpoints (3 by default) of 802, each with the params the task supplies (URLs and @handles resolved), the params still missing, the credit cost and the exact call. Free; no key needed.

task.description: The job in plain words; URLs and @handles in it are resolved and filled. Omit to list platforms.

platform.description: Only this platform's endpoints (slug, e.g. 'tiktok'); alone, lists them.

tools.name: socialcrawl_endpoint
tools.description: Read before calling: one endpoint's purpose, params, where the rows are and up to 25 response fields, cost rule, paging, latency, timeout, next endpoints and a sample link. By id, platform+resource or path. Free.

id.description: 'platform/resource' for its contract; a platform slug for its endpoint table; or a guide topic (errors, pricing, pagination, judgments, hydration, overview).

method.description: Only for an id served by several methods.

tools.name: socialcrawl_estimate
tools.description: Exact credits before you spend: one call (id, platform+resource or path, plus the params you will send; calls for a job total; items for a walk) or a plan of several calls. Uses the API's estimator when available, else the bundled pricing. Free.

id.description: 'platform/resource'; a platform slug for its price table; none for the overview.

params.description: The exact params you will send.

calls.description: Number of such calls (an array is read as plan).

plan.description: Several calls to total, instead of id.

tools.name: socialcrawl_request
tools.description: Call one endpoint (platform+resource, or id, or path). Validated locally first (a bad call is free), quoted, refused above max_credits and confirmed above the threshold. A large page is cut at row boundaries; socialcrawl_collect result_id reads the rest. Spends credits; needs SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY.

platform.description: Platform slug, e.g. 'tiktok'. An unknown slug gets a did-you-mean.

resource.description: Resource path, e.g. 'post/comments'; path params as 'jobs/{job_id}' + params.job_id, or the concrete path.

method.description: Only for a resource served by several methods (prism/jobs). Inferred: a body selects POST.

params.description: Query params, e.g. { handle: 'x', limit: 10 }. Arrays join with commas (label). Sent as strings.

body.description: JSON body for POST batch endpoints, e.g. { ids: [...] }.

idempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe: a replay returns the original response for 0 credits (24h).

fields.description: Row paths as socialcrawl_endpoint lists them, e.g. 'post.id,post.engagement.*' (or an array). Cuts tokens.

max_items.description: Show at most this many rows; the full page stays behind the result link.

max_credits.description: Spend cap: refused free when the quoted hold exceeds it (collect: the walk's budget).

confirm.description: true only once the user approved spending above the threshold (default 100 credits).

tools.name: socialcrawl_collect
tools.description: Walk a paged endpoint (id, platform+resource or path) to `items` unique rows, the last page or max_credits: cursors supplied, duplicates dropped, stops on a 402, refused free when one page exceeds max_credits. Small results come back whole. Spends credits.

id.description: platform/resource of a paged endpoint, e.g. 'tiktok/post/comments'.

params.description: Params for every page, as in socialcrawl_request. No cursor.

items.description: Stop once this many unique rows are collected.

max_credits.description: Spend cap: refused free when the quoted hold exceeds it (collect: the walk's budget).

fields.description: Row paths as socialcrawl_endpoint lists them, e.g. 'comment.text,comment.engagement.likes'.

confirm.description: true only once the user approved spending above the threshold (default 100 credits).

result_id.description: Read a stored result instead of walking. Free.

tools.name: socialcrawl_account
tools.description: Free: balance (default, with this session's spend), transactions (ledger), usage (by api_key, day, endpoint or tag; ≤92 days), status (health; check before retrying a 502/503), freshness (vs live catalogue), notifications (inbox).

tools.name: socialcrawl_manage
tools.description:
By area + action: monitors, cohorts, web (scrape, crawl, agents, page monitors, sessions), jobs, discover, search_runs (search lists, watches), creator_runs, review_history, events (feed, webhooks). Wrong fields refused free. Managing is free; scrapes, jobs, queries, run_more/include, monitor runs bill.
dry_run: true quotes, creating nothing. rows_new alerts need track. Docs: discover-runs, search-runs.

action.description: monitors: create|list|get|runs|timeseries|export|pause|resume|update|delete. cohorts: create|add_members|estimate_cost|query|query_*|get|delete. web: scrape|search|map|extract|crawl|batch_scrape|agent|crawl_preview|job_*|monitor_*|session_*. jobs: submit|list|get. run_* = list|get|export|legs|cancel|resume|more. discover: run_*|schedule_*|input_*|follow. search_runs: run_*|run_include|watch_*|follow. creator_runs: run_*|run_save|follow. review_history: get|bulk_get|bulk_cancel. events: feed|ack|endpoint_*.

input.description: The action's fields (a job body may add max_credits, confirm). rows_new alert rules: socialcrawl_endpoint id=monitors.
